Transgenic zebrafish live, confocal microscopy imaging at 5 days post-fertilization with fluorescent protein expression in ngn1+ and erbb3b+ cells. This combination of transgenes was used to visualize sensory neurons of dorsal root ganglia and associated glial cells such as satellite glia and Schwann cells in the peripheral nervous system.

One fish imaged, pseudo-colored rainbow, and arranged to mimic peacock feathers. Image edited using ImageJ and Affinity Designer.

  • Gt(:gSAIz-GAL4FFD)nkgsaizGFFD37A
